title: They Know the Intruder
hook: An ear-splitting explosion destroys the cathedral entrance as armed figures emerge through the smoke.
sinker_question: Who is the stranger powerful enough to command the royal guards' loyalty?

title: She Is to Be Executed
hook: A devastated mother tells her son that his wife is to be executed.
sinker_question: What will the dead Duke do when he reaches the wedding before his wife's execution?

title: Bare Hands
hook: A smiling tormentor orders the woman to retrieve something with her bare hands before the magistrate arrives.
sinker_question: Can she survive the garden ordeal and save her husband?

title: Alexander Died
hook: A terrified nobleman stares at the approaching stranger and insists, "Alexander died!"
sinker_question: What will the rightful Duke do to the man who stole his life?

title: Married, Then Disowned
hook: The priest pronounces Juliana and the penniless stranger husband and wife in front of her stunned former groom.
sinker_question: Will Juliana abandon her new husband to preserve her family and status?

title: The Door Bursts Open
hook: A violent crash tears open the burning bedroom door, and a man bursts through the smoke.
sinker_question: How will they escape when fire has sealed the doorway?

title: Name Your Price
hook: Still in bed with the bare-chested priest, the woman abruptly asks him to name his price.
sinker_question: What will the maid do with the dangerous secret she witnessed?

title: The traitor runs for the door
hook: Rupert desperately screams that he was only told Alexander was dead.
sinker_question: Can Lord Sterling escape the consequences of the conspiracy?

title: The maid is Lady Juliana
hook: Catherine rips Juliana's mother's locket from her neck as Juliana cries out.
sinker_question: What will Catherine do now that she knows the maid's true identity?

title: Burn Every Page
hook: Catherine tells the chained, tearful Juliana to say goodbye to her mother as the ledger burns.
sinker_question: What will Catherine try next when the ledger fails to break Juliana?

title: One-Punch Protector
hook: The stranger blocks a charging guard and drops him with one bone-rattling strike.
sinker_question: Why is this dangerous stranger risking himself for the rejected woman?

title: The Duchess makes her a maid
hook: Alexander orders Catherine thrown beyond the estate gates while she screams for mercy.
sinker_question: Will the proud noblewoman accept service under the woman she tortured?
